In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover a two major stories shaping the Indian economy and global markets:
1. New Electricity Rules Could Change How India Pays for Power
We will look into how the government’s new draft rules could change electricity pricing through time-based tariffs, new charges on rooftop solar users, and possible battery mandates for large consumers. These changes aim to fix grid inefficiencies and push smarter energy usage across India.
